title: stable-envs-v1: Fast and Reproducible Environments with Controllable Variations
abstract: arXiv:2611.23151v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training World Models (WMs) relies on processing large amounts of high-dimensional data, which typically needs to be stored, read into memory, and moved from memory to compute units. In principle, GPU-native rendering avoids this movement of large image tensors from memory to compute cores, allowing for better GPU utilization, and training speed-ups. Rendering on-demand also allows to control perceptual appearance through the application of visual variations on-the-fly, allowing for higher diversity in training. To this end, we introduce stable-envs, an open-source library for fast, GPU-native rendering allowing to apply controllable variations on multiple simulation environments. By rendering image observations directly on GPU, stable-envs allows end-to-end training speed-ups of up to 1.33x, with no loss of performance. translated_title: stable-envs-v1：具有可控变化的快速且可复现的环境
translated_abstract: 训练世界模型依赖于处理大量高维数据，这些数据通常需要被存储、读入内存，并从内存移动到计算单元。原则上，GPU原生渲染避免了将大型图像张量从内存移动到计算核心的过程，从而实现更好的GPU利用率以及训练加速。按需渲染还允许通过即时应用视觉变化来控制感知外观，从而在训练中实现更高的多样性。为此，我们引入了stable-envs，一个用于快速GPU原生渲染的开源库，可在多个模拟环境中应用可控变化。通过直接在GPU上渲染图像观测，stable-envs实现了高达1.33倍的端到端训练加速，且不损失性能。除了更快的训练运行之外，stable-envs还通过批处理物理实现了可复现的大规模评估……
tldr: stable-envs是一个开源的GPU原生渲染库，通过直接在GPU上渲染图像观测并支持可控的视觉变化，实现了高达1.33倍的端到端训练加速且不损失性能，同时支持可复现的大规模评估。
en_tdlr: stable-envs is an open-source GPU-native rendering library that achieves up to 1.33x end-to-end training speed-ups without performance loss by rendering image observations directly on GPU with controllable visual variations, while enabling reproducible large-scale evaluations.
